Intended as a race-ready ATV, the LT-R450 was developed with the help of WPSA ATV champion Doug Gust, and featured a fuel-injected 450 cc 4-stroke DOHC single cylinder engine, based on the powerplant found in the RM-Z450 racer.  The LT-R450 was a replacement for the LT-Z400.  The 2008 model was a significant update over the 2007 model, with a claimed power increase of 3 hp as well as over 100 upgrades.  In 2009, Suzuki stopped importing the LT-R450 into the United States, after 25,396 units had been sold.  As a result of emissions control breaches on both the LT-R450 and the RMX450Z, the EPA fined Suzuki 885,000.
